items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: Both of his brothers were good. The sport was real good too.

ctx.x: Trombone. Good tone, good rhythm, good harmony and you know the chorus.
Yeah, I know he's a good man. Both of his brothers were good. The sport was real good too. Good musician. Now they worked in the foreign dance after I came out. They worked there for many years.
I remember when Austin worked there. I guess his brother too I heard.
